diff --git a/fastapi/_compat.py b/fastapi/_compat.py
index 8ea5bf25..f56ed340 100644
--- a/fastapi/_compat.py
+++ b/fastapi/_compat.py
@@ -589,6 +589,13 @@ def field_annotation_is_complex(annotation: Union[Type[Any], None]) -> bool:
     origin = get_origin(annotation)
     if origin is Union or origin is UnionType:
         return any(field_annotation_is_complex(arg) for arg in get_args(annotation))
+    if origin is Annotated:
+        # Handle Annotated types inside Annotated types, e.g. tagged unions with a
+        # Discriminator, like:
+        # Annotated[Annotated[ModelA, Tag("a")] | Annotated[ModelB, Tag("b")], Discriminator(...)]
+        annotated_args = get_args(annotation)
+        if annotated_args:
+            return field_annotation_is_complex(annotated_args[0])
 
     return (
         _annotation_is_complex(annotation)
diff --git a/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py b/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py
index e49380cb..497fa163 100644
--- a/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py
+++ b/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py
@@ -837,6 +837,10 @@ def is_union_of_base_models(field_type: Any) -> bool:
     union_args = get_args(field_type)
 
     for arg in union_args:
+        # Unwrap Annotated types, e.g. for tagged unions with a Discriminator, like:
+        # Annotated[Annotated[ModelA, Tag("a")] | Annotated[ModelB, Tag("b")], Discriminator(...)]
+        if get_origin(arg) is Annotated:
+            arg = get_args(arg)[0]
         if not lenient_issubclass(arg, BaseModel):
             return False
